source.title: Chaos Space Marines Faction Pack: Version 1.3

data.summary: Whenever this model's unit finishes a **Charge move**, choose one enemy unit in **Engagement Range** of this model, then roll a D6 for it: on 2-3 that unit takes 1 **mortal wound**, on 4-5 D3 **mortal wounds**, and on 6 D3+3 mortal wounds.
